economy.summary: As House Agriculture Committee chairman, Thompson led House passage of a new farm bill in May 2026, saying an updated farm bill meeting farmers' current needs is long overdue; he says the bill strengthens supply chains, expands credit access for producers, enhances crop insurance, and invests in rural broadband and infrastructure.
economy.short: Led farm bill: supply chains, producer credit, crop insurance, rural broadband.

taxes.summary: Voted for the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, calling it the largest tax cut in American history that boosts take-home pay, and said it makes the 2017 tax provisions permanent.
taxes.short: Voted for tax bill making 2017 tax cuts permanent.

abortion.summary: His campaign website states he is fighting for the sanctity of human life for the innocent unborn and at every age and stage.
abortion.short: Says he fights for sanctity of life, including the unborn.

education.summary: A longtime career and technical education advocate who co-authored the Perkins CTE reauthorization signed into law, he testified in March 2025 urging appropriators to strongly support Perkins CTE state grant funding for FY 2026.
education.short: Co-authored Perkins CTE law; urges stronger federal CTE funding.

healthcare.summary: Introduced the bipartisan HEALTH Act to secure Medicare reimbursement for telehealth services at community health centers and rural health clinics, including audio-only visits, saying telehealth increases access to care for rural and underserved communities.
healthcare.short: Introduced HEALTH Act expanding Medicare telehealth for rural clinics.

energy.summary: Supports expanded domestic energy production, including Marcellus Shale natural gas, saying Pennsylvania's oil and gas industry has helped lead America to energy independence; he supported the Protecting American Energy Production Act.
energy.short: Supports Marcellus Shale gas production and American energy independence.

guns.summary: Cosponsored the Constitutional Concealed Carry Reciprocity Act of 2025 (H.R. 38), which would allow concealed-carry permit holders to carry handguns in other states that permit concealed carry.
guns.short: Cosponsored national concealed carry reciprocity bill H.R. 38.

economy.summary: Citing the loss of more than 10,000 Pennsylvania farms in a decade, he supports the Agricultural Right to Repair Act, protecting crop insurance, and returning tariff decisions to Congress, and proposes legislation encouraging small business, small manufacturing, local banks, and farm operations to create local jobs in rural communities.
economy.short: Supports farm right-to-repair, crop insurance, congressional tariff authority, rural jobs.

taxes.summary: Supports extending the enhanced health-insurance premium tax credits used through Pennsylvania's Pennie marketplace, saying the failure to extend them produced premium increases of 129-160% in some district counties.
taxes.short: Supports extending enhanced Pennie health-insurance premium tax credits.

education.summary: Supports expanding grants to attract qualified STEM teachers to rural schools, and opposes federal cuts to rural education grants and to Penn State research funding.
education.short: Supports rural STEM teacher grants; opposes education and research cuts.

healthcare.summary: Opposes Medicaid cutbacks and VA cuts that delay veterans' treatment, citing the May 2026 closure of Bradford Regional Medical Center and an eight-county maternity care desert in the district.
healthcare.short: Opposes Medicaid and VA cuts; cites rural hospital closure.

energy.summary: Supports Pennsylvania natural gas production while demanding stronger corporate oversight, real consequences for violations, and environmental accountability, and wants clean-energy construction and manufacturing jobs prioritized locally.
energy.short: Supports natural gas with stronger oversight; prioritizes clean-energy jobs.

guns.summary: A gun owner who says he believes in the Second Amendment, he supports more comprehensive background checks, saying he is shocked at how easy it is to buy a weapon.
guns.short: Gun owner supports Second Amendment and more comprehensive background checks.
